ruleDefinitions.name: Linux Network Service Scanning Tools Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of network scanning and reconnaisance tools. These tools can be used for the enumeration of local or remote network services for example.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\/nc$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/ncat$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/netcat$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/socat$")) AND  NOT ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-listen\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-l\\ .*")))) OR (process_path = RGX("\\/autorecon$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/hping$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/hping2$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/hping3$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/naabu$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/nmap$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/nping$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/telnet$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/zenmap$"))
